protocolDosing.notes: blend/co-formulation of the amylin analog cagrilintide + the GLP-1 agonist semaglutide; investigational (Phase 3 REDEFINE). No validated standalone dosing — research/community protocol

mechanismOfAction.summary: Co-formulation: long-acting amylin analog (cagrilintide) + GLP-1 receptor agonist (semaglutide).
mechanismOfAction.description: Fixed-ratio combination of the amylin/calcitonin-receptor agonist cagrilintide and the GLP-1R agonist semaglutide, combining complementary satiety pathways for enhanced weight loss. Under Phase 3 evaluation (REDEFINE program).
